neighbours.label: A function word right after the object of allow, prevent or until in engineering or maintenance instructions, before a physical-process verb ('allow the rotor [to] accelerate', 'prevent the reactor water [from] boiling off')
fire: Before takeoff the gyroplane is towed slowly to allow the rotor to accelerate in the wind.
Cooling was needed to prevent the reactor water from boiling off after the shutdown.
Turn the compressor off and allow the air to completely purge from the tank before opening it.
Keep the rotor controlled from the moment it starts to spin until it has come to a full stop.
Let the engine idle for two minutes to allow the oil to circulate through the bearings.
A cover is fitted to prevent the snow from entering the intake during the winter months.
Wait until the pressure has dropped to zero before you loosen the fittings on the line.
Open the valve slowly to allow the steam to escape from the boiler without a sudden jump.
quiet: Before dinner the family sits quietly to allow everyone a chance to say what they are thankful for.
The teacher asked the class to prevent any noise during the test, and the students stayed calm.
Turn the music off and ask the neighbours to come over for a cup of tea in the garden.
Keep the dog on a lead from the moment you leave the house until you reach the park.
Let the dough rest for an hour so the bakery shelves can be filled by noon.
A sign was put up to remind the visitors that the garden closes in the winter months.
Wait until the guests have arrived before you start the music in the main hall.
Open the window slowly so the cat can look out at the birds on the roof.
